HibProjection

Source: R/class_projection.R
HibProjection-Class.Rd

This is the template object for a an R6 class containing the results of projecting a fitted HibModel based on data of interest. It contains functions for summarising and visualising the results.

Details

Template object for projection results

Public fields

last_update

(character)
Identifies the most recent update to the object (YYYY-MM-DD).

model

(R6)
The model used to project, one of HibModelLME4, HibModelINLA, HibModelBRMS.

projection

(data.frame, SpatRaster, or list)
The results of model projection.

projection_specs

(list)
List of specifications used for modelling.

aoa

(list)
Results of Area-of-Applicability calculations.

Method new()

Creates a new instance of this R6 class. Note, this object is constructed via the hib_project_model function found within this package.

Usage

HibProjection$new(
  obj,
  proj,
  backtransform,
  rescale_specs,
  lme4_specs,
  inla_specs,
  brms_specs,
  aoa_res
)

Arguments

obj

(HibModelXXXX)
The model object used in cross-validation.

proj

(data.frame, SpatRaster, or list)
The results of model projection.

backtransform

(function or NULL)
Describes the backtransformation specified when making a model projection. relative to the baseline land-use class.

rescale_specs

(list)
List of specifications used for rescaling predictions.

lme4_specs

(list)
List of specifications used for lme4 models.

inla_specs

(list)
List of specifications used for inla models.

brms_specs

(list)
List of specifications used for brms models.

aoa_res

(list, or NULL)
List of Area-of-Applicability results.

Method plot()

Function to generate figures summarising the projection results.

Usage

HibProjection$plot(
  type = "response-map",
  response_var = NULL,
  uncertainty_var = NULL,
  aoa_mask = FALSE,
  aoa_var = NULL
)

Arguments

type

(character()) Options are: "response-map", "uncertainty-map", "bivariate-map", "response-distr", "uncertainty-distr", "bivariate-distr".

response_var

(character, or NULL)

uncertainty_var

(character, or NULL)

aoa_mask
